population.span: patients at high cardiovascular risk (age of ≥50 years with established cardiovascular or chronic kidney disease, or age of ≥60 years with cardiovascular risk factors only)

endpoint.span: The primary outcome in a time-to-event analysis was the first occurrence of a major adverse cardiovascular event (death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke).

estimate.span: Major adverse cardiovascular events occurred in 61 of 1591 patients (3.8%) in the oral semaglutide group and 76 of 1592 (4.8%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.79; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.57 to 1.11; P<0.001 for noninferiority).

analysis_set.span: Overall number of participants analyzed = full analysis set (FAS) which comprised all randomised participants.

treatment_strategy.span:
Participants were to take once-daily semaglutide tablets in a dose escalation manner for upto 82 weeks: 3 mg from week 0 to week 4, 7 mg from week 4 to week 8 and 14 mg from week 9 to upto week 82.
RESULT OUTCOME 0 GROUP OG001: Placebo | Participants were to take oral semaglutide placebo tablets once-daily for a period of upto 82 weeks.

follow_up.span: The median time in the trial was 15.9 months.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria require adults with type 2 diabetes and elevated cardiovascular risk, a subset of the question's population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Male or female diagnosed with type 2 diabetes * Age at least 50 years at screening and presence of cardiovascular disease, or age at least 60 years at screening and presence of at least one cardiovascular risk factor

notes: Registry spans supply the analysis set and assigned dosing regimen. All randomised participants were included in the FAS, supporting the served ITT designation. Follow-up is the observed median trial duration; registry results include observation after treatment discontinuation through the follow-up visit.
